refnamediv.refpurpose: API for provisioning systems with basic settings

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.FirstBoot is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

Configure() applies Settings to the host, or to the root directory or disk image passed as file descriptor (rootFileDescriptor, imageFileDescriptor with imagePolicy), the same way systemd-firstboot1 does: locale, keymap, timezone, hostname, machine ID, root password and similar settings. The names of the settings actually written are returned in applied; settings that were already configured are left alone unless force is set. This is what lets provisioning tools configure a first-boot system without running the interactive tool. The interface is experimental.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: The interface is served by systemd-firstboot.service1 on the /run/systemd/io.systemd.FirstBoot socket, which is SocketMode=0600 and therefore only connectable by the superuser; that is required, since the method rewrites system configuration and accepts a file descriptor to a root directory or disk image. No polkit interaction takes place. The socket accepts connections (Accept=yes, up to MaxConnectionsPerSource=16) and starts one systemd-firstboot@.service instance per connection, i.e. each connection performs a single configuration pass; the same service is what runs the configuration on a first boot.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# API for provisioning systems with basic settings, see systemd-firstboot(1). # [Experimental] interface io.systemd.FirstBoot
# Basic system settings, as systemd-firstboot configures them. type Settings( # The system locale, i.e. LANG=, e.g. 'de_DE.UTF-8'. locale: ?string, # The locale for messages, i.e. LC_MESSAGES=. localeMessages: ?string, # The console keymap, e.g. 'de'. keymap: ?string, # The timezone, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'. timezone: ?string, # The static hostname. hostname: ?string, # The machine ID, formatted as 32 hexadecimal characters. Only accepted when a root directory or image is specified, or force is true. machineId: ?string, # Tags to label the machine with, see machine-info(5). machineTags: ?[]string, # The root password in plain text, it is hashed before it is stored anywhere. Mutually exclusive with rootPasswordHashed. rootPassword: ?string, # The root password, already hashed in a format crypt(3) understands. Mutually exclusive with rootPassword. rootPasswordHashed: ?string, # The shell of the root user, as absolute path. rootShell: ?string, # Additional kernel command line options. kernelCommandLine: ?string )
# Applies settings to the host, or to the root directory or disk image passed as file descriptor, the same way the systemd-firstboot command line tool does. Settings that are already configured are not changed, unless force is set. Requires root privileges. method Configure( # Index of a file descriptor passed along with the call, referring to the root directory to operate on. If unset, the host is configured. Mutually exclusive with imageFileDescriptor. rootFileDescriptor: ?int, # Index of a file descriptor passed along with the call, referring to a disk image or block device to operate on, instead of the host. It is dissected and mounted for this. Mutually exclusive with rootFileDescriptor. imageFileDescriptor: ?int, # Image policy to dissect the image with, see systemd.image-policy(7). imagePolicy: ?string, # The settings to apply, at least one must be set. settings: Settings, # If true, overwrite existing configuration files, like the --force switch. Defaults to false, i.e. settings that are already configured are left as they are. force: ?bool ) -> ( # The names of the fields of the settings parameter that were written to the system. Specified settings that were skipped, because they were configured already, are not listed. applied: []string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.FirstBoot shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.FirstBoot.Configure '{}' invokes its Configure() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.FirstBoot interface was added in version 263.
Configure(), and Settings were added in version 263.
